title: Dropped Rust fragmentation sessions leak tuple reservations
description: FragmentationPolicy reserves sender_rule/receiver_rule at construction, but FragmentSender and AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver have no Drop cleanup and policy has no expiry/reclaim API. If a caller drops or abandons a ready/active session without explicit cancel/release, the T=0 tuple stays SessionBusy indefinitely until unrelated peer-policy refresh. Add ownership-safe RAII/reclaim or expiring reservations that cannot free a live replacement, for std and no_std, with drop-before-start/drop-active/panic/error/cancel/id-reuse tests.
notes: Robustness review broadening: receiver has no inactivity-timeout API; raw terminal/error paths can become Succeeded/Aborted without policy release; authenticated allocation exhaustion only errors rather than emitting the required one Receiver-Abort. Cover all terminal/error/drop paths.
